slides.statSub: Points scored against Tola in ten weeks
slides.say:
The most anyone has faced through Week 10 since 2021.
He's fourth in the league in points. He's 4‑6.

slides.title: Sunday is the Luck Bowl

cards.name: Tola
cards.ln: 4th in points. A 64‑46 record if he played everybody every week, second-best in the league.

cards.name: Adam
cards.ln: 7th in points. A 55‑55 record against everybody. Tied for first anyway.

slides.kicker: One of them has the second-best team on paper. The other has the standings.

slides.title: How you get there

cards.name: Tola's opponents
cards.ln: Ran into the week's highest score twice. In Week 10 he put up 164.98, second-most in the league, and lost.

cards.name: Adam's opponents
cards.ln: Three of his last four opponents posted the lowest score of the week. Wes, David, Chris. 74.72 was the last one.

slides.kicker: Nobody since 2021 has faced the week's worst score more than three times through Week 10. Adam's tied.

slides.title: Eleven teams have been 4‑6 after Week 10
slides.kicker: Adam's odds: 95%. He's done this before: 7‑3 in 2024 with the 11th-most points. Made the playoffs.

slides.title: Somebody's luck runs out Sunday
slides.say:
Tola vs. Adam. The most points against through ten weeks since 2021, versus the guy whose opponents keep saving their worst week for him.

Three weeks left after this one. Tola needs it. Adam just needs it to keep happening.
